title: delivery-failed, version 1
description: IN message a connector writes when it gives up on an OUT message (dead letter, exchange contract 1.0, section 7.6). Row: direccion 'IN', tipo_mensaje 'delivery-failed', the endpoint_logico, correlacion_id and ref_externa of the failed OUT row, msg_id_externo 'delivery-failed:<out id>'. The engine defines the deftemplate delivery-failed for every package (T13).

out-id.description: id of the failed OUT row.

out-type.description: tipo_mensaje of the failed OUT row.

attempts.description: intentos of the failed OUT row: the number of times it was claimed for sending.

reason.description: Last error, one line, at most 1000 characters (the OUT row's error column).
